Class SparseGraphDataPreparer

java.lang.Object
orientationStructures.SparseGraphDataPreparer
Direct Known Subclasses:
DirectedToNNDigraph, UndirectedToNNDigraph
public abstract class SparseGraphDataPreparer extends Object
Base helper for preparing sparse-graph data used by DirectedToNNDigraph and UndirectedToNNDigraph.

This class stores the input edge records, builds object-to-index lookup structures, converts string-labeled edges to integer-labeled triples, and computes membership in the 2-core on a supplied graph instance.

Concrete subclasses are responsible for constructing the final directed or undirected graph objects.

Author:
R. W. R. Darling

  • Method Details

    • setSourceTargetWeightList

      public void setSourceTargetWeightList(List<StringPairWithWeight> edgeRecords)
      Sets the source-target-weight records used by subsequent preparation steps.

      This is typically the first method to invoke before buildObjectIndex() and buildEdgeList().

      Parameters:
      edgeRecords - list of "source, target, weight" triples. In extensions of this abstract class, edges will be declared as directed or undirected.

    • buildObjectIndex

      public void buildObjectIndex()
      Builds an index over all source and target labels that appear in the stored edge records.

      Both source and target columns are used because a vertex may have out-degree zero while still having positive in-degree.

      The method populates:

      • objectStringLookup: index-to-label map via list position
      • vertexIndex: label-to-index map
      • nV: number of distinct vertices

    • buildEdgeList

      public List<org.jgrapht.alg.util.Triple<Integer,Integer,Double>> buildEdgeList()
      Converts the stored string-labeled edge list into integer-indexed weighted triples.

      Each output triple has the form (sourceIndex, targetIndex, weight) and is suitable for sparse-graph constructors that accept primitive integer vertex identifiers.

      Returns:
      list of triples suitable for input file for the SparseIntDirectedWeightedGraph constructor.

    • determineTwoCore

      public void determineTwoCore(org.jgrapht.graph.AbstractGraph<Integer,Integer> abstractGraph)
      Construct lists of edges and vertices outside the two core, without regards to whether edges are directed or not.

      Results are stored in vertexIsInTwoCore and edgeIsInTwoCore for later filtering by subclasses.

      Parameters:
      abstractGraph - graph on integer vertex and edge identifiers; typically a sparse directed or sparse undirected weighted graph in an extending class
